### **About Calian**

**At Calian, we help organizations overcome obstacles, manage risks, and drive progress.** Since 1982, we’ve grown from a small consulting firm into a trusted global company across defence, space, health, nuclear energy, public safety, and government.

We create innovative solutions that tackle complex challenges and help organizations and communities stay resilient, informed, and connected. **If you’re driven by purpose and energized by solving real-world challenges, we want you on our team.**

**Job Type:** Student

Ottawa, ON | On-site | Student Role – January 2027

### **Position Overview**

Calian’s AI Integration team builds internal automation and tools powered by AI that make daily work easier for groups across the business, including finance, engineering, HR, and manufacturing. These tools are built quickly to solve real problems, so they need to be made reliable, thoroughly tested, and ready for everyday use.

This role exists to give that testing and hardening work a dedicated owner. The co-op student’s main focus is software testing: putting our tools through their paces in a safe, sandboxed environment so they are solid before the people who rely on them use them. Alongside testing, the student takes on their own scoped projects, such as equipment tracking, and gets real opportunities to learn how to build automation with AI, with guidance at every step.

We are hiring for genuine enthusiasm. A curious, excited person who loves figuring out how things work can be taught the rest.

### **Responsibilities**

* Software tool testing (primary focus, the majority of the term): put newly built AI tools through their paces in a safe, sandboxed environment. Find edge cases, try to break things, document issues, and confirm fixes before tools reach the people who use them.

* Test equipment automation: help script and automate tests that involve lab or test equipment, making repetitive test runs faster and more repeatable.

* Own scoped projects: take ownership of clearly defined projects such as equipment tracking, with the guidance needed to succeed.

* Opportunities to build (occasional, growth oriented): as the student grows, take on real build tasks and learn to create AI tools, supported by mentorship and review.

* Collaboration and documentation: work with contacts across departments to understand what tools need to do, and write simple notes so others can use them.

* Other duties as required within the context of the role.

### **Qualifications**

This is a student work term. No prior professional experience is required.

Education

* Currently enrolled in a college or University program. Students from any computer, engineering, or technology program are welcome to apply.

Required

* Genuine enthusiasm for automation and AI. This matters most by far. Show us you are excited through a personal project or a story about something you built. It does not have to be about automation. Show us something you have made that you are proud of.

* Curiosity and a “let us see how this works, and how it breaks” mindset.

* Willingness to spend the term focused on testing, knowing that real chances to build are part of the role.

* Some comfort with programming is a plus and, above all, an eagerness to learn.

Nice to have (assets)

* Any experience with lab or test equipment.

* Experience experimenting with AI tools, LLMs, or building with prompts.

* Familiarity with version control (git), Excel and spreadsheet automation, or scripting on Windows.

Compensation

$26.01- $28.82/hour

Vacancy

We have 1 available position.

**AI Usage Disclosure**

*At Calian, we do not use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to screen or evaluate candidates. AI tools may support backend administrative tasks, but they do not influence hiring decisions. All evaluations and decisions are made by real people on our recruitment team and hiring managers. All applicants are reviewed and only those chosen for an interview will be contacted by our recruiting team.*

**Why Work for Calian**
-----------------------

### **Work Environment**

* No one-size fits all! We give teams freedom of choice in building an ideal work environment.
* Flexible hours, on-site, hybrid, or work from home options depending on the role requirements.

### **Impact**

Calian is a publicly traded company that keeps the world moving forward.We inspire confidence in our customers’ ability to communicate, innovate, learn, and lead safe and healthy lives.This confidence is achieved through synchronized efforts across our organization to provide our customers with solutions inAdvancedTechnologies, Health, Learning, and IT& Cyber Solutions. This role is part of our corporate team and will work closely with all internal clients who support these business units

### **Growth and Innovation**

Calian is a technology company with an aggressive growth agenda based on our ability to solve significant and complex problems for our customers. In this role, you will be a key member of the Calian.

We put our people first. We encourage employees to advance their Calian career through professional development and corporate career. Calian is an innovative and growing organization—have your ideas heard by pitching to senior leadership through the Calian Idea Contest!

### **Culture**

We lead with trust. We reinforce personal responsibility and accountability. Calian fosters collaboration through open communication and promotes an environment of learning and professional growth.

### **Diversity and Inclusion**

Calian fosters an environment that allows employees to maximize their potential, by nurturing a culture where everyone is valued for their differences.

### **Total Rewards**

* A balanced approach to work and life as we understand the importance of your personal lives.
* Stock purchase plan with additional contribution from Calian
* RRSP Matching Program

### **CEO Quote**

And according to our CEO... **“A freaking awesome team!”**

### **Calian Students & Interns**

* Work on interesting projects that have a real-world impact
* Gain industry experience in a collaborative team-based environment
* Have regular 1:1s with experienced team members
* Develop skills for career advancement and growth
* Are encouraged to participate in team building and company social activities
